PIT.week6_result: W 26-19 OT at TB (Oct 18). Pittsburgh rallied from a 13-point fourth-quarter deficit (largest comeback entering the 4th since 1992); Rodgers threw for 253 yards and 2 TDs, rookie Germie Bernard caught the OT winner and Jalen Ramsey's sack of Jalon Daniels on 4th-and-8 ended it. CB Brandin Echols left with a hamstring injury on a punt; S Jaquan Brisker (groin) returned; HC Mike McCarthy hurt his ankle/foot and skipped the halftime interview.

qb.backup: Mason Rudolph (Will Howard third, Drew Allar fourth)
qb.notes: Rodgers healthy; 1,487 yards, 12 TD, 5 INT through six games in what he says is his final season. He criticized the Tampa playing surface after the game.

Tyler Shough 16-of-30 for 144 yards, 3 TD plus a rushing TD; 175 team rushing yards. CB Kool-Aid McKinstry exited with a migraine.
